title: Code Review 2026-06-09
description: 10 prioritised items from the full-repo code review. Items 1–4 are blocking pre-launch; items 5–10 are steady-state improvements.

workstreams.title: XSS: HTML sanitization
workstreams.description: Vendor DOMPurify; shared quote-safe escHtml; apply across every vault render path.

tasks.title: Vendor DOMPurify alongside fuse.js in _common/js/vendor/
Wrap every marked.parse output with DOMPurify.sanitize in sg-article-viewer
One shared escHtml module that escapes &, <, >, ", ' (replace three ad-hoc copies)
Apply escHtml at every nav-derived innerHTML interpolation in sg-side-nav, sg-sub-nav, and all three SPA shells
Allowlist link protocols in marked renderer (https?, mailto:, relative URLs only)
Replace onclick-string patterns with addEventListener + dataset (dev shell CI rows, run cards)

workstreams.title: Lambda: host allowlist (RCE surface)
workstreams.description: Lambda@Edge builds orchestrator URL from request headers, then import()s it. Validate host against hardcoded allowlist before fetching.

tasks.title: Add host allowlist in infra/lambda-edge/sg-edge-render/index.mjs:61 before orchestrator fetch

workstreams.title: CI: pinning + permissions
workstreams.description: Prod dispatch deploys whatever branch it runs on; external actions pinned to mutable @dev branch with secrets:inherit.

tasks.title: Add ref: ${{ inputs.git_branch }} to checkout step in ci-pipeline.yml
Pin owasp-sbot/OSBot-GitHub-Actions actions to commit SHAs
Add least-privilege permissions blocks to all five workflow files
Migrate from static AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID/SECRET to OIDC role assumption

workstreams.title: CI: gating tests
workstreams.description: Push → deploy with zero checks. Smoke test is non-gating. Edge-render harness and Playwright spec both unwired from CI.

tasks.title: Make post-deploy smoke exit non-zero on failure (deploy_static_site.py:472)
Wire tests/edge-render/run-local.mjs into CI as gating job (run per manifest route)
Add package.json + portable Playwright config; fix hardcoded machine paths in tests/e2e/qa-vault-content.spec.js

workstreams.title: Extract shared sub-site-shell.js
workstreams.description: ~450–500 of ~1500 combined inline lines across library/dev/invest are duplicated and have already drifted. Extract one shared ES module.

tasks.title: Extract routing, loading state, TOC, breadcrumbs, prev/next, section/group/404 views into _common/js/sub-site-shell.js
Parameterize by { base, siteTitle, vaultId, readKey }; expose as ES module default
Dev CI/kanban views become plug-in renderers passed in via options object
Port showHome + suppressToc and all other drift fixes to dev and invest shells simultaneously

workstreams.title: Runtime bugs: race, cache, leaks
workstreams.description: Stale render race in article-viewer; vault-cache replays errors as HTTP 200; blob URL leaks across navigations.

tasks.title: Pass seq into _renderArticle; bail before innerHTML inject if seq !== this._loadSeq
Coalesce attributeChangedCallback via queueMicrotask in sg-article-viewer (mirrors sg-side-nav pattern)
Store + replay {buf, status, statusText} in sg-vault-cache.js:193 for deduped joiners
Call _revokeBlobUrls() at top of _load() in sg-article-viewer, not only in disconnectedCallback

workstreams.title: Deploy: Cache-Control + content-type
workstreams.description: All files deploy as no-store (site is uncached end-to-end). Html sync pass forces text/html on .mjs, .xml, .txt.

tasks.title: Restore tiered Cache-Control in deploy_static_site.py: 300s HTML / 1d CSS+JS / 7d fonts+images
Fix html sync pass: include only *.html; let a catch-all pass handle remaining types with guessed MIME
